title: Tum Rehgaey Jaakar Kahan Abbas Kahan Ho
body:
Khaymon Mein Hai Aah-o-Buka Abbas Kahan Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Tooti Hai Kamar Shah Ki Aur Zakhmi Bahot Hain (x2)
Uthti Nahi Laash-e-Javan Abbas Kahan Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir Pay Talvaaron Ki Yalghaar Hai Uttho (x2)
Har Zakhm Hai Noha Kuna Abbas Kahan Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Kartay Hain Sitam Jashn Manaatay Hain Sitamgar (x2)
Hain Qaid Mein Shehzaadiyan Abbas Kahan Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Raak Pay Bethi Hoowi Aur Khaak Hai Sar Par (x2)
Bai Haal Hain Saidaanian Abbas Kahan Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Dur Chingaey Lagtay Hain Sakina Kay Tamaachay (x2)
Yeh Kamsini Yeh Sakhtiyaan Abbas Kahan Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Ayk Shor Bapa Giaara Muharram Ko Tha Gohar (x2)
Ho Akbar-o-qasim Kahan Abbas Kahan Ho
